text:
Priya: seeing a wave of tiny-gang evictions in eu-west1 this morning, multiple customer jobs restarted.

Mike: spike around 08:05 UTC, can you paste logs?

Priya: snippet:

Priya: ```
W0830 08:05:12 scheduler.go:421] preempting pods for pod=batch-train-42
I0830 08:05:13 provisioner: scale-up triggered for gpu-pool (4 -> 8)
I0830 08:05:14 kubelet: pod batch-train-42 evicted: preemption
```

Anya: provisioning started but nodes weren't Ready before evictions. Any AZ mismatch?

Chris: provisioner created nodes in eu-west1-b while most pending pods had strict zone affinity for eu-west1-c. Cloud API returned 429/insufficient on c and fallback caused cross-zone packing.

Priya: that scattered gang pods across racks and created GPU fragmentation; then preempt waves hit.

Mike: autoscaler/backoff too aggressive. we should avoid evicting when a scale-up is in-flight for the same zone.

Anya: options:
- increase provisioner retry to prefer same-AZ
- relax affinity for tiny-gang (risk perf)
- add transient scheduler holdback while scale-up stabilizes

Priya: proposal: zone-aware "provision-stabilize" window (30s) where scheduler suppresses aggressive preempt for pending pods if scale-up observed in target zone.

Mike: +1 30s initial. emit metric `scheduler.provisioner_cooldown_mismatch` to alert spikes during scale-ups.

Anya: gate per-zone: only suppress if new nodes are in same AZ as pending pods.

Chris: config sketch:

Chris: ```yaml
scheduler:
  provisionStabilizeWindow: 30s
  zoneAware: true
```

Priya: opening PR and will canary in staging with trace replay. tagging @Chris @Mike for review.

ops-bot: alert: eu-west1 preemptions > 40 in 5m

sre-oncall: investigating. 3 customer jobs restarted so far, no 5xx spike.

Priya: canary results: during replay preemptions dropped ~75%, node Ready latency unchanged.

Anya: rolling to prod with 1h ramp. runbook updated with rollback steps.

Chris: also propose a burst/burst-pool for tiny pods to improve binpacking long term.

Mike: include cost/latency tradeoff in RFC; tune stabilize window after real data (maybe 15s later).

Priya: PR: https://github.com/redwood/scheduler/pull/842

Priya: dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/scaleup/preemptions-vs-scaleups

sre-oncall: tagging P2. will update if issues.

Priya: closing thread once prod is stable. :white_check_mark:
